description: Na₂TiO₃ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four TiO₆ octahedra, edges with four TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-16°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.49 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four TiO₆ octahedra, edges with four TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-16°. There are two shorter (2.21 Å) and four longer (2.46 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with six NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 16°. There are two shorter (2.27 Å) and four longer (2.28 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 13°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.02 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-14°. There are two shorter (1.99 Å) and four longer (2.00 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Ti atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Ti₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-11°. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Ti atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Ti₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-13°. In the third O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Ti atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Ti₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-13°.
